newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed recovers on lower arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed recovers on lower arrivals.

text.p: Castorseeds recovered from lower start on Thursday pulled by reports of lower new crop arrivals, traders said.
The March delivery contract bounced back to 1,134/1,135 rupees per quintal after starting at 1,129/1,130 rupees.
"Arrivals dropped at the producing centres due to severe cold weather conditions," one trader said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 341/343 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 70/80 tonnes, while physical offtake was slow.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
